title: User App Prototype Device/Browser QA Harness
completionDefinition: Phase 7H should add browser/device-like QA harness coverage for the local User App Shell readiness and mobile interaction flows.
7H must not add production app scope, backend, database, cloud sync, analytics, real camera capture, AR, training, online publication, native iOS scope, external APIs, or new runtime dependencies.
Browser/device QA must preserve local-only, non-sensitive, deterministic boundaries.
Docs and project-state must remain recoverable.
dependsOn: 7G User App Mobile Interaction QA / App Readiness Gate
